reviews.note: Adds Canada with the darkness confined to Toronto, and puts the planning with the leaders rather than the nations.
New claim. The link between the European and American financial buildings is the checkable part.
Names the four banks and adds the mime image. The same four institutions are named across several separate bank claims in this corpus, which weakens naming them as a distinguishing detail.
Earliest telling, 10 June 2026, a day before the 11 June version this claim was seeded from. Here they are porcelain dolls rather than kimonos and are placed in Europe as well as Asia.
The swastika as a bat signal over Europe.
Great distractions and manipulation by fear. Any news cycle satisfies this.
The summoning framed as the cause of the war. Nothing here can be checked.
Turkey closing the strait for Russia. His wife supplies the name of the waterway, not the vision, and the strait she names is the Dardanelles rather than the Bosphorus.
Reads the song as a rebellion or an attitude of indifference over Europe, which is the first interpretation offered for it.
Adds the cobwebs, tumbleweeds and sage grass on the buildings as the state before the change.
The glory on the darkened bells and the church becoming alive.
Adds that the shaking falls on the Catholic Church and the Protestants alike, and that they are running out of time.
The bells repeated at the end of a three hour broadcast.
New claim. No reading is offered beyond the number, which is the same 250 that recurs across the anniversary material.
He calls the Mount of Olives earthquake symbolic of America, which allows a non physical reading of a claim he elsewhere gives as a literal quake.
A first domino to do with America. No event, place or date is given.
A general statement of expectation with no date.
Adds the booing and the safety concern, and the line that the Lord already said nothing would happen. A claim that nothing will happen is the safest form of prediction available.
New claim. The reading is a seismograph trace rather than felt shaking; distant instruments record every large earthquake, which is not the same as it shaking Alaska.
The Cuban earthquake read as the sign that the liberation is close.
A shaking to awaken coming to Cuba, with the earth in travail.
He says the cluster is not coincidence. A 5.2 in Greece is routine and Greece records several a year.
He holds the peace and the world war at once in the same passage, which is why this claim cannot fail in either direction.
He corrects bothered to an urgency to pray, which is worth recording as how the impression is characterised.
He says he would not have thought the betrayal was with the president. That is a revision of who the betrayer is, made after the fact, and it is recorded rather than smoothed.
Prayer for a named group on an Israel tour. No forward content.
He cannot make out the footage and says so.
This will be worse and it happens in the night, with the China and North Korea meeting alongside.
Counter drone measures at all seventy eight matches, taken from an official clip. Worth noting the authorities are ahead of the claim here rather than behind it.
He narrows it himself: not the building but the extremities outside it, which is a real tightening.
The three men in the Hawaii mall, with the luxury store named and a red dawn frame.
Attributes the arson to Muslim actors and extends the range from Toronto to British Columbia. North American investigations have generally found other causes.
New claim. He states in advance that he does not know what the green shirt means and that it was being looked up, which is worth crediting.
Adds two places at once, Israel and America, as the shape of it.
He thanks God for the shaking and calls it a sign without checking the magnitude or whether anyone was hurt, and says so himself.
Late counted ballots moving toward one party read as fraud, argued from pattern rather than from a word.
New claim, and unusually checkable: a named condition, an election outcome, and a specific arranged event that either happens or does not.
He credits the prayer for the salvations and healings reported and says it is just the beginning.
Footage of people lying in the street at a meeting, presented as the wave arriving.
The make no little plans motto and the founder's scale applied to his own ministry.
A Japanese eruption in the news used to restate the Fuji claim. Japan has roughly 111 active volcanoes, so an eruption elsewhere does not settle a Fuji claim.
Signs in the heavens and earth with a Russian eruption. Around fifty volcanoes are erupting worldwide at any given time.
An 8.6 in the Philippines. He asks whether this is it rather than asserting it, which is the right form.
Adds the Vatican, the Temple Mount and Malibu as places about to shake, and points back to a word given the previous week.
New claim. The identification is made now rather than when the vision was given, which is the pattern worth tracking on all his animal symbols.
Macron leading the charge and talking to bankers, with the French slogan read out.
Ties the CERN portals to summoning Hitler's spirit and to Europe burning. Nothing here can be checked.
He is told to listen closely in the meeting and hears the plan to bring war.
A British political clip. Not a claim he makes.
Big European lawsuits against Musk, claimed as called in advance, with a Marilyn Monroe candle noted in the frame.
The debt arithmetic used as a rhetorical device rather than a forecast.
The debt given as the mechanism by which the dollar has to be displaced for the beast system.
A description of his own experience in prayer. No forward content.
Adds that it is a planned staged event on a greater scale than the 2020 unrest, which is a specific comparison and therefore checkable.
Joins the green to the New York rioting and adds that it is all races.
